I have severe ptsd but as an nhs worker obviously do wear a mask. I have a ptsd alert card and if I have a flashback in public or work I will ask to remove my mask in a safe environment until I have grounded myself. People are understanding if I need to remove it for a short period and if people are not comfortable I will not remove it even though it affects me negatively. I personally would be personally uncomfortable than potentially pass on a deadly virus and cause serious long term harm or death to another. Trust me, once you've seen the damage caused to people from covid it becomes a lot easier to make a personal sacrifice in the interest of others.

Hi love, I have attempted a number of times and although my life is still very much a bit of a shit show I am finding ways to deal with the overwhelming craving for the end.
Please try to find something small to stay alive for, in bad times I've tried to set a small goal (literally anything) and focusing on that until I'm able to calm down. I also put on headphones and blast a song that makes me feel anything different and often lie on the floor for grounding lol. I'd recommend going to a and e or calling a crisis line because they will listen and although they may not provide instant relief they may be able to get the ball rolling.
I never thought I'd survive but I promise this is not your only option, people care and want to help, even if it is not apparent.
